'''Tray'Essek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] criminal enforcer who was active during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At one point in his past, Tray'Essek was humiliated and betrayed by his fellow clansman [[Lar'omx]]. A follower of the Trandoshan religion, in line with Trandoshan traditional beliefs, Tray'Essek's [[Jagannath point/Legends|jagannath points]] were zeroed out, leaving him without a place of honor in the afterlife. Tray'Essek subsequently sought to restore his position by [[Death/Legends|taking the life]] of his betrayer, and he vowed to devote the rest of his life to tracking Lar'omx down and to ensuring that no-one else killed his rival first. After learning that Lar'omx was working for the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], Tray'Essek joined the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]], in hope that service to the Syndicate would provide him with an opportunity to encounter Lar'omx once again.<ref name="UABS" />

After the [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kaa'to Leeachos]] betrayed the Pykes, Tray'Essek was among a group of Pyke-affiliated operatives assigned to track the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] down, and the group subsequently traced Leeachos' movements through the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the mission, Tray'Essek finally came face to face with Lar'omx again, in an encounter inside the [[Spyder]], an underworld [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] establishment. The operatives later confronted Leeachos inside an abandoned wing of the [[NovaCORE kelerium processing plant]], in [[The Works/Legends|The Works]] district.<ref name="UABS" />
